description: List the 26 AI motion clip templates (single-shot prompts for landscapes, macro food, animals, products, abstract loops, city nights, weather, miniatures, fantasy scenery and short-drama beats in thriller, comedy, horror, romance, action, epic and drama; the clips are silent, and any person is only a silhouette, seen from behind or as hands, never a face or a child). Each has the full prompt, genre, a six-slot breakdown (camera, subject, action, setting, style, lighting: each phrase is literally in the prompt), a one-line why, seconds, credits, a demoVideoUrl when a sample clip exists, and the arguments for generate_motion_clip (pass its id as templateId, or edit the prompt and pass it as prompt). Pass id for one template, or genre (drama, thriller, comedy, horror, romance, action, epic, nature, product, fantasy) to filter. Nothing is created or charged; show the user the price before you generate. Free.
name: list_motion_templates
title: List motion clip templates
